name: v_all_house
comment: Primary data table for house surveys. gid: house unique_id. sid: survey unique_id. ct: containers. pc: positive_containers (aggregate of data in v_all_cont). aa_*: aedes aegypti.  na_*: non-aedes aegypti.

name: v_all_cont
comment: Primary data table for container / immature surveys

name: v_all_spray
comment: Primary data table for ULV spraying. Date is the putative date of treatment; date_upper is the latest possible date of spraying. spray_record: NIH = experimental spraying; DIRESA = MoH citywide.

name: v_spray_dates
comment: Convenience table, number of spray application attempts per calendar date

name: v_all_cage
comment: Primary data table for control cages

name: v_join_house_par_cont
comment: Convenience table: joins house, parity, and container surveys

name: v_agg_survey_counts
comment: Convenience table: observation counts of all surveys

name: v_join_house_tx
comment: Convenience table: joins house surveys with prior spray applications. Only includes spray region houses during spray periods.

name: all_circuit2
comment: Convenience table: names and labels of experimental circuits
